announcements.headline: Amendment to Bond Conditions
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates a modification to the terms governing the company's debt instruments, which may affect the cost of capital or covenants for bondholders. For equity shareholders, this is typically an administrative update with limited direct impact unless it signals financial distress or significant refinancing.
